theorems.name: Submission.cbrr_ud_uniformize_eventually
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (F : Set (Euclid P)) (T : ℝ → Set (Euclid P)), MeasurableSet F → μ F ≠ ∞ → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → IsClosed (T ρ)) → (∀ x ∈ F, ∀ᶠ ρ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), x ∈ T ρ) → ∀ η : ℝ≥0∞, η ≠ 0 → ∃ (E : Set (Euclid P)) (δ : ℝ), E ⊆ F ∧ 0 < δ ∧ μ (F \ E) < η ∧ ∀ x ∈ E, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < δ → x ∈ T ρ
